title: Activity work
responsibility: Shows recent committed work and its recorded component reasons.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.work
inputs.description: Required ordered commit summaries with branches, time, file/unit/reason counts and sampled unit/reason details. Full unit count falls back to listed length for its displayed count.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.href
inputs.description: Required callback producing each commit-page address.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.recorded
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True labels reasons as recorded on the commit or accepted by its records; false says recorded on the commit.

outputs.name: ActivityWork
outputs.description: Recent-work list with five commits initially, expansion control and per-commit details. Shows branches or on no branch, counts, reasons and notices when additional details live on the commit page. No reasons and no commits are stated explicitly.
